_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/otack-agent/projects.json. A project absent from this file is invisible to the agent — not read-only, invisible. `write: false` lets the agent research and comment but never modify the working tree. `in_progress_column`/`review_column` name the board columns the agent moves a card into when it starts and when it hands over — a column id (int) or its exact name (string, e.g. "В работе"); omit either to leave that move up to the agent's judgement (see agent/skill/references/phases.md).
